name: core.openwop.workflows.market-intel
description: Real-work workflow pack (RFC 0013, ADR 0149/0150 + ADR 0174). Market-intelligence digest + a SHIFT digest (research the current period, then diff against the prior run via market-intel.shift-detect → an in-voice shift summary) authored entirely over PUBLISHED node packs (vendor.myndhyve.market-intel-* + core.openwop.ai), so they expand + run on any conformant host. Published under the `core.openwop.workflows.*` namespace (openwop-team signing key); the registry adds `signing` at publish time.
author: openwop

chains.label: Competitive / market-intel digest
chains.description: Discover sources for a topic, extract voice-of-customer signals, score opportunities, then synthesize a digest with recommended actions. Portable: every node is a published typeId.

topic.description: The market/topic to research (e.g. 'AI workflow orchestration for mid-market ops teams').

audience.description: Optional audience framing for the synthesis.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's LLM nodes. Frozen into this chain's AI nodes when the workflow is created (ADR 0498 — a concrete provider is what keeps replay deterministic). Override at instantiation to use a different vendor or your own BYOK provider; whichever you pick, the workspace needs a key for it — the workflow will not fall back to another provider on its own.

model.description: Model id for this chain's LLM nodes. Must be advertised by `provider` in the host catalog; override at instantiation.

config.systemPrompt: You are a market analyst. Synthesize a concise competitive/market-intel digest with recommended actions for the topic "{{params.topic}}"{{params.audience}}, using the discovered sources, voice-of-customer signals, and opportunity scores.

digest.description: The synthesized market-intel digest with recommended actions.

chains.label: Market-intel SHIFT digest (vs prior run)
chains.description: Research the current period (discover → voc → score), diff it against the PRIOR run's synthesized records/angles via market-intel.shift-detect, then synthesize a concise shift digest (what's new / resolved / intensifying + angle-score moves). Schedule it (RFC 0052) to get a recurring shift watch. Portable: every node is a published typeId.

topic.description: The market/topic to re-research (same framing as the prior run).

previous.description: The PRIOR run's synthesized result — { records: [{quote,tagType,confidence?}], angles: [{id|name,score}] } — to diff against.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's LLM nodes. Frozen into this chain's AI nodes when the workflow is created (ADR 0498 — a concrete provider is what keeps replay deterministic). Override at instantiation to use a different vendor or your own BYOK provider; whichever you pick, the workspace needs a key for it — the workflow will not fall back to another provider on its own.

model.description: Model id for this chain's LLM nodes. Must be advertised by `provider` in the host catalog; override at instantiation.

config.systemPrompt: You are a market analyst. Given the detected market shift (new / resolved / intensifying pain points and angle-score deltas) for the topic "{{params.topic}}", write a concise SHIFT digest: what changed since the last run and the recommended next actions. If no material shift was detected, say so plainly.

shiftDigest.description: The synthesized market-shift digest (what changed + recommended actions).
